title: Early Termination Fee Conditions and Termination Date - C&I
content:
*Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: early termination fee: when it is assessed and which date governs.*

## Clauses in force

1. A C&I early termination fee is assessed only once the contract is termination pending or closed.
2. Only one early termination fee may be billed per C&I contract.
3. No fee applies when the contract is ended from holdover or after the contract end date, or when the utility rejected the enrollment.
4. The termination date is the termination effective date for a noticed termination and the close date for a switch-away or a final bill.
5. Facility closure, sale, bankruptcy and dissatisfaction with market prices do not waive the fee.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

- that for a pre-flow termination all of the term's months count as remaining, as the pre-flow basis provides;
- that otherwise the remaining months are twelve times the difference in years plus the difference in months between the termination date and the contract end date, plus one when the day of month of the contract end date is later than that of the termination date;
- that the remaining kWh are the facility's annual kWh usage multiplied by the remaining months and divided by 12 months per year, rounded half up to a whole kWh, and that the fee is the remaining kWh multiplied by the structure's rate per kWh, rounded half up to the cent, but not less than the structure's minimum fee.

## Assessment by situation (status and lines read from the contract)

| Situation | Early termination fee |
|---|---|
| termination pending after written notice during the term | may be assessed |
| closed during the term: early termination, switched to other supplier, final billed, or terminated before flow | may be assessed |
| an early termination fee line already on the contract | no second fee |
| ended from holdover (close reason holdover ended) | none |
| ended after the contract end date | none |
| enrollment rejected by the utility | none |
| active, pending enrollment, or holdover with no termination | not assessed |

## Points of judgement

- A business that closes or sells the facility, enters bankruptcy or is dissatisfied with market prices still owes the fee where it applies.
- For a contract that closed because another supplier enrolled the facility, the termination date is the close date.
